name: ntfy
author: safloresmo
description: Receive your ntfy notifications from one or several servers (ntfy.sh or your own): a desktop notification for every message and a panel with the history, links and attachments. Servers and topics are edited in the panel. English by default, Spanish when the system locale says so.

barWidget.description: ntfy push notifications in the bar.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Send a desktop notification for every incoming message. The panel keeps the history either way.

schema.label: Minimum priority to notify
schema.description: ntfy priority (1 min … 5 max) from which to notify. Below it, history only.

schema.label: Messages to keep
schema.description: History cap in ~/.local/state/sfm/ntfy/. Servers and topics are edited with the panel's gear (~/.config/sfm/ntfy.conf).
